story.headline: The Mullins Miracle and an Eighth Final Four
story.text: With transfers Silas Demary Jr. and Malachi Smith and freshman Braylon Mullins joining Alex Karaban, Tarris Reed Jr. and Solo Ball, UConn went 34–6. The Huskies beat No. 7 BYU in Boston, won at Kansas, beat Florida in the Jimmy V Classic and started 12–0 in the Big East, finishing second. Emeka Okafor's No. 50 was retired in February, and Karaban became the first active men's player inducted into the Huskies of Honor. Karaban, Demary and Reed made first-team All-Big East — the league's first trio from one team. After a 72–52 loss to St. John's in the Big East final, the No. 2 seed Huskies beat Furman (Reed: 31 points, 27 rebounds), UCLA and Michigan State, then erased a 19-point second-half deficit against No. 1 overall seed Duke: Demary deflected a pass, Karaban found Mullins, and Mullins buried a 35-foot three with 0.4 seconds left, 73–72. UConn beat Illinois in the Final Four before Michigan won the title game 69–63 — UConn's first loss in seven title games.

moments.text: UConn beat Furman 82–71 in the NCAA tournament first round at Xfinity Mobile Arena, Philadelphia, PA.

moments.title: NCAA Second round: W vs UCLA
moments.text: UConn beat UCLA 73–57 in the NCAA tournament second round at Xfinity Mobile Arena, Philadelphia, PA.

moments.title: NCAA Sweet Sixteen: W vs Michigan State
moments.text: UConn beat Michigan State 67–63 in the NCAA tournament sweet sixteen at Capital One Arena, Washington, D.C.

moments.title: The Mullins miracle
moments.text: Braylon Mullins' 35-foot three with 0.4 seconds left completes a 19-point comeback over No. 1 Duke, 73–72.

moments.title: NCAA Final Four: W vs Illinois
moments.text: UConn beat Illinois 71–62 in the NCAA tournament final four at Lucas Oil Stadium, Indianapolis, IN.

moments.title: NCAA National Championship: L vs Michigan
moments.text: UConn lost to Michigan 63–69 in the NCAA tournament national championship at Lucas Oil Stadium, Indianapolis, IN.

photos.caption: New Haven Chargers vs. UConn Huskies: Game Highlights
Dan Hurley doesn't hide his frustration after UConn's close loss to Arizona and rips up the stat sheet.
Braylon Mullins' breakout performance lifts UConn over KU
UConn wins a slugfest against Florida in the Jimmy V Classic at Madison Square Garden.
UConn men's basketball coach Dan Hurley lights up his team's defense after the Huskies lose at home to Creighton.
Rick Pitino takes full blame for St. John's 32-point loss at UConn and says the team will move on.
Dan Hurley addresses the technical foul that led to his ejection in UConn's 68-62 upset loss.
After a nice steal, UConn's Alec Millender drives to the basket and gets a friendly roll off the top of the backboard for an and-1.
UCLA's Donovan Dent tosses it up to Xavier Booker for a two-handed flush early on.
Dan Hurley joins "The Pat McAfee Show" and discusses facing Tom Izzo and Michigan State in the Sweet 16 on Friday night.
UConn pulls off an incredible comeback victory over Duke as freshman Braylon Mullins sinks a logo 3-pointer with less than a second to go.
Chris Webber joins Rich Eisen to break down what he likes about Illinois before its Final Four matchup vs. UConn.
